changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwAppUser AS SELECT u.id, u.login, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.image_url, u.activated, u.lang_key, u.created_by, u.created_date, u.last_modified_by, u.last_modified_date, u.phone_number, u.birth_date, u.gender, u.job_role, u.security_access_level, u.allow_ongoing_visit, u.can_un_discharge_urgent_care, u.can_un_complete_encounter FROM public.app_user u;

changeSet.author: asklepios
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwAppUser TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwAppUser FROM report_user;
